author: fangrys
quote:
Game is total garbage. Boring and tedious chores, forced to have a girlfriend you have to cater to. 

Restricts your freedom and how you want to play and engage with the game like you can't run over people in the parades, can't shoot up a club, can't get hookers or alternate girlfriends from what I've seen thus far.

The games actual performance is terrible. It's forced to be 30fps but struggles with even that and can potentially drop to like.. 15fps. The game has numerous bugs as well, some are funny haha whatever and some are like game breaking bugs like.. Cyberpunk launch levels of bad. 

Also.. $100 for all of this BS... definitely not worth playing. Your money is better spent elsewhere.
